name: com.vivoderin.joycon2
description: Nintendo Switch 2 Joy-Con over Bluetooth LE as Input System gamepads: one Joy-Con held sideways = one player. Buttons, stick, gyro, accelerometer and attitude on Windows, macOS, Android, iOS and WebGL (Chrome/Edge, Bluefy). Native BLE plugins included.

samples.description: Minimal two-player setup: each Joy-Con 2 moves its own cube; tilt and Select recenter; a Connect button for WebGL.
